result.title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
result.summary: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextual representations, with a task-conditioned gate modulating the final hidden-state update. This enables task-adaptive iterative refinement. Together, these components encourage the model to identify predictive relationships from contextual contrasts during pretraining and dynamically modulate context integration for each task. Across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets, TAFFY attains the lowest average rank.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出表格基础模型 TAFFY，用带干预与分布偏移的合成上下文构造「上下文内多样性」先验，并用任务条件门控的循环 Transformer 迭代精炼上下文表示，在多个分类与回归基准上取得最低平均排名。
AI.relevance_reason: 循环共享块加任务条件门控的隐状态更新机制，可能为 LVR 中循环推理状态生成与动态计算控制提供借鉴线索，尚需核查其门控是否真正按任务调制而非仅做深度扩展；表格任务本身不含视觉推理。
